name: Vestige of the Schism
summary: The Object that never dies: it returns to the Retire Zone and rearms the Front.

face.name: Vestige of the Schism

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: The Entity it is assigned to has +2 Power. When that Entity dies, put the Vestige into your Retire Zone instead of the Abyss. Then you may assign another Object from your Retire Zone, without paying its Flux cost, to an Entity without an Object you control.

face.flavor: What remains of the Schism does not stop serving.
